summary.method: Lattice Boltzmann D3Q19, regularized BGK + Smagorinsky LES (Cs 0.17), half-way bounce-back walls, momentum-exchange forces

validation.note: Same solver and wall treatment. At the bike's resolution (main tubes about 6-8 cells across) absolute drag reads high; differences between configurations are the reliable output.
